WITH target AS (
  SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols
  WHERE file_id = 'auto_ontology/server/models.py' AND name = 'ApiModel' AND kind = 'class'
), direct AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cb.class_symbol_id
  FROM code.class_bases cb
  JOIN target t ON cb.base_symbol_id = t.symbol_id
), indirect AS (
  SELECT ca.class_symbol_id, ca.depth
  FROM code.class_ancestry ca
  JOIN target t ON ca.ancestor_symbol_id = t.symbol_id
  WHERE ca.depth >= 2
)
SELECT i.class_symbol_id, MIN(i.depth) AS depth
FROM indirect i
WHERE i.class_symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT class_symbol_id FROM direct)
GROUP BY i.class_symbol_id
ORDER BY depth, class_symbol_id

request:
Which classes inherit from ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/models.py) only indirectly, i.e. through at least one intermediate class of this repository, and do not name ApiModel directly in their class statement? An import alias of ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/responses.py imports it as _Payload) counts as naming ApiModel directly, and a subscripted base such as ListResponse[T] counts as its class. For each, give the class symbol ID and the length of the shortest inheritance chain to ApiModel (2 when the parent class directly subclasses ApiModel).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), depth (integer).
explanation: Finds the ApiModel class symbol in auto_ontology/server/models.py, then uses class_ancestry to get all classes reaching it at depth >= 2. It excludes classes that name ApiModel (or an alias resolving to it) directly as a base, and returns the shortest inheritance depth for each remaining class.

WITH target AS (
  SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols
  WHERE file_id = 'auto_ontology/server/models.py' AND name = 'ApiModel' AND kind = 'class'

  JOIN target t ON cb.base_symbol_id = t.symbol_id
), indirect AS (
  SELECT ca.class_symbol_id, ca.depth
  FROM code.class_ancestry ca
  JOIN target t ON ca.ancestor_symbol_id = t.symbol_id
  WHERE ca.depth >= 2
)
SELECT i.class_symbol_id, MIN(i.depth) AS depth
FROM indirect i
WHERE i.class_symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT class_symbol_id FROM direct)
GROUP BY i.class_symbol_id
ORDER BY depth, class_symbol_id
